about.title: A one-person game studio, founded in Istanbul.
about.lede: CopperHand Studio is a solo developer. Every game in the catalogue is designed, programmed and released by one person, from the first prototype to the store page.
name: Copper is a metal you work by hand. You hammer it, etch it, engrave it. Before photography, pictures were printed from engraved copper plates, each one cut slowly and numbered in the engraver's catalogue.

That is the idea behind the studio and this site. Each game is made carefully by one pair of hands, gets a number when it ships, and keeps its own colours and mood. The studio around it stays quiet, so the games can be loud.

principles.title: One person, end to end
principles.body: Design, code, testing, store pages and player support are handled by the same developer. When you write in, you reach the person who made the game.

principles.title: Small enough to finish
principles.body: Each game is scoped so it can be finished and polished, then kept alive with updates instead of being left behind.

principles.title: Every game its own world
principles.body: There is no house style for the games. A math race on the ice and whatever comes next do not have to look alike. Each one is built around what makes it fun to play.

contact.title: Write to the studio.
contact.lede: There is one inbox and the developer reads every message. Pick a topic below and your mail opens with the right subject line.

topics.title: Player support
topics.subject: Support:
topics.body: Something not working in one of the games? Mention which game, your device and OS version, and what happened. A screenshot helps.

topics.title: Press and creators
topics.subject: Press:
topics.body: Writing about a game, making a video or streaming it? Ask for screenshots, the trailer, or anything else you need.

topics.title: Business
topics.subject: Business:
